source: Kazusa Codon Usage Database (representative published Escherichia coli K-12 values)
build: hand-curated representative table, per-thousand codon frequencies
note: These are REPRESENTATIVE published Escherichia coli K-12 codon-usage values (Kazusa-style, per-thousand), NOT an authoritative per-genome recount from a specific CDS set. They reflect well-known E. coli biases (e.g. strong preference for CTG at Leu and CGT/CGC at Arg with rare AGA/AGG). Frequencies are relative usage on a positive scale; only ratios within an amino acid's synonymous group matter for relative adaptiveness and CAI. Do not present these as an exact genome-wide count.
